title: MikroTik RouterOS: 2 flaws used in attacks; attackers can get in without a password
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 63 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. The severity score is critical (9.2).

category.label: Routers, cameras and devices
category.why: Routers, cameras and recorders are often forgotten and rarely updated.
category.doThis: Update it or replace it. Never leave its admin page open to the internet.

summary: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 13, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
